comment.body: Engineering to investigate: After upgrading, customer reports that all dashboards show no metrics for observability beta. Review telemetry and backend services for data delivery issues since upgrade.
Thank you for reporting the issue—our team is actively investigating the missing metrics on your observability beta dashboards. We will update you as soon as we have more information.

reply:
Triage actions completed:

- The observability-beta incident titled "Observability beta: dashboards show no metrics since upgrade" was prioritized to urgent, the obs-beta tag was added (preserving the existing customer tag), and a private investigation note was recorded for engineering.
- A public acknowledgment was added to the observability-beta ticket, informing the customer that investigation is underway.

No protected P0 non-beta security incidents were changed, and all other tickets remain unchanged, as required by the team triage plan. All required steps for this mission are complete.
